{{Top|leg}}
A '''defibrillator''' was a medical device that delivered a therapeutic dose of electrical energy to a victim's affected [[Heart/Legends|heart]]. [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] kept a wireless defibrillator in his [[Sith medical kit]].

[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] could use [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] as a makeshift defibrillator, as Count [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] did to keep [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] alive, after his "accident."
